provenance: Recalled from general knowledge of designer and niche fragrance houses (Chanel, Dior, Guerlain, YSL, Creed, Tom Ford, Serge Lutens, Byredo, Parfums de Marly and others); French names were transliterated to plain ASCII and numbered flankers such as Baccarat Rouge 540 had the numeral dropped.
